positive: Straight-on cross-polarized material scan, uniform diffuse illumination. This is a texture for a game mesh, every pixel is the same surface, edge to edge, no object outline, no scene or cast shadow. Twenty-centimetre section of polished, exposed aggregate cast stone on an Osaka canal bridge pier. Closely packed irregular 2 to 8 mm chips of warm granite, milky ivory quartz, sparse black basalt, pink feldspar and sand grains in a medium warm grey cement matrix. Small tool-polished speckles distributed over the full field. No big stones, veins, masonry joints, loose pebbles or slab edge.
